Rebuild the quiz builder page at `/Users/yashbaldha/Desktop/Shopify App/QuizSnap/app/routes/app.quizzes.$id.tsx`. Read the current file first to understand the existing structure (1333 lines, 3 tabs). ## GOAL Build a brand-level quiz editor inspired by top Shopify quiz apps (Octane AI, RevenueHunt, Quiz Kit). The editor should have **5 tabs**, type-specific question editors, score management, product tag mapping, quiz settings, skip logic, and a live design preview. ## DATABASE SCHEMA (for reference) Question fields: id, quizId, type, title, description, imageUrl, required, position, settings (JSON), logic (JSON) Answer fields: id, questionId, text, imageUrl, position, score, productTags (JSON), nextQuestionId, metadata (JSON) Quiz fields: id, shop, title, description, slug, status, type, settings (JSON), styling (JSON) ## IMPORTS AVAILABLE ```typescript import { authenticate } from "../shopify.server"; import { boundary } from "@shopify/shopify-app-react-router/server"; import db from "../db.server"; import { showToast } from "../utils/toast"; ``` ## ARCHITECTURE RULES 1. `authenticate.admin(request)` first in loader AND action 2. Shop-scoped queries always 3. Polaris v13 only — minimal inline styles (only for grid layouts, color swatches, preview mock) 4. Toast on every mutation 5. TypeScript strict — zero `any` 6. parseSafe for all JSON fields ## 5 TABS ### Tab 1: QUESTIONS (most important — the core editor) **Layout**: Left sidebar (1/3) + Right editor panel (2/3) **Left Sidebar**: - Header: "Questions" + count badge - Scrollable list of question cards, each showing: - Number badge (1, 2, 3...) - Question title (truncated) - Question type as Badge (e.g., "Single Choice", "Slider") - DragHandleIcon (visual only — real drag-drop is future enhancement) - "Add question" button at bottom (opens a type picker dropdown) - Selected question highlighted with `bg-surface-selected` background and `border-focus` border - Click to select - Empty state when no questions **Right Editor Panel** (for the selected question): - Header: "Question {N}" + type badge + Delete button - FormLayout with: - Question title (TextField) - Question description (TextField, multiline=2, optional) - Question type (Select dropdown — changing type resets type-specific settings) - Required checkbox **Type-specific editors** (below the common fields, separated by Divider): For **multiple-choice** (type: "multiple-choice"): - "Allow multiple selections" checkbox (stored in settings.allowMultiple) - Answer options list: - Each answer: number + TextField (label) + TextField (score, type=number, width small) + delete button - "Add option" button - Product tags section per answer (expandable per option): - Each answer shows its tags as Tag components - "Add tag" input per answer For **image-choice** (type: "image-choice"): - Same as multiple-choice BUT each answer also has an imageUrl TextField - Answer list shows: image URL input + label + score + delete For **dropdown** (type: "dropdown"): - Same answer list as multiple-choice (no "allow multiple" checkbox) - Dropdown-specific: help text "Options will appear in a dropdown menu" For **slider** (type: "slider"): - NO answer options section - Instead show settings fields: - Min value (TextField, type=number) - Max value (TextField, type=number) - Step (TextField, type=number) - Unit label (TextField, e.g., "minutes", "days") - Min label (TextField, e.g., "1 min") - Max label (TextField, e.g., "30+ min") - All stored in question.settings JSON For **email** (type: "email"): - NO answer options section - Settings fields: - Consent text (TextField, multiline=2, e.g., "I agree to receive...") - Skip link text (TextField, e.g., "Skip and see results") - Stored in question.settings JSON For **text-input** (type: "text-input"): - NO answer options section - Settings fields: - Placeholder text (TextField) - Max character length (TextField, type=number) - Stored in question.settings JSON For **rating** (type: "rating"): - NO answer options section - Settings fields: - Maximum rating (Select: 3, 4, 5, 7, 10) - Rating style (Select: "Stars", "Numbers", "Hearts") - Stored in question.settings JSON For **date** type (if type is "date" — but we don't need this for now, skip it) **IMPORTANT**: The answer options section (with score, tags) should ONLY show for types that have answers: multiple-choice, image-choice, dropdown. For slider/email/text-input/rating, show the type-specific settings instead. ### Tab 2: PRODUCT MAPPING Keep the existing ProductMappingTab mostly as-is but with these improvements: - Collapsible sections per question (use a toggle/disclosure) - Show answer score next to each answer name - Better empty state ### Tab 3: DESIGN **Layout**: Left panel (2/3) + Right preview (1/3) **Left Panel** — 3 cards: Card 1: "Quiz Content" - Quiz title (TextField) - Description (TextField, multiline=3) Card 2: "Appearance" - Primary color (TextField with color swatch prefix, hex code input) - Button text color (TextField, default "#FFFFFF") - Button text (TextField, default "Next") - Font family (Select: "System default", "Inter", "Poppins", "Playfair Display", "Roboto") - Border radius (Select: "Sharp (0px)", "Rounded (8px)", "Pill (24px)") Card 3: "Progress & Navigation" - Show progress bar (Checkbox) - Progress bar style (Select: "Bar", "Steps", "Percentage") — only if progress bar is on - Show question count (Checkbox, e.g., "1 of 5") - Results page heading (TextField, default "Your Results") **Right Preview Panel** (1/3 width): - Card with "Preview" header + "Live" badge - Mock phone frame showing: - Progress bar (if enabled, using primary color) - Quiz title - Sample question text - Sample answer options (3 boxes) - CTA button (with primary color and button text) - "This preview reflects your current design settings" caption ### Tab 4: SETTINGS (NEW) Single column layout with cards: Card 1: "Quiz Information" - Quiz title (TextField, required) - Quiz description (TextField, multiline=3) - URL slug (TextField, prefix="/quiz/", helpText="Used in the storefront URL") - Quiz type (Select: Product Recommendation, Personality, Assessment, Survey, Lead Gen) Card 2: "Email Capture" - Require email before results (Checkbox) - Email consent text (TextField, multiline=2) - helpText: "Configure email capture behavior across the quiz" Card 3: "Embed & Sharing" - Embed code section showing a readonly text box with: `
` - "Copy code" button - helpText: "Add this code to your storefront theme to display the quiz" ### Tab 5: LOGIC (NEW) Display per-question branching rules. Layout: List of questions, each expandable to show logic rules. For each question that has answer options: - Question title as heading - "Add rule" button - Rules list: - Each rule: "If answer is [Select: answer options] → Go to [Select: question list + "Results page"]" - Delete rule button - If no rules: "No branching rules. Quiz will follow sequential order." - Info banner at top: "Set up conditional logic to create personalized quiz paths. Questions without rules follow the default sequential order." Logic is stored in question.logic JSON field as: ```json { "rules": [{ "answerId": "xxx", "goto": "questionId" | "results" }] } ``` ## LOADER Load quiz with all questions, answers, and result pages: ```typescript const quiz = await db.quiz.findFirst({ where: { id: quizId, shop: session.shop }, include: { questions: { include: { answers: { orderBy: { position: "asc" } } }, orderBy: { position: "asc" }, }, resultPages: { orderBy: { position: "asc" } }, }, }); ``` Return parsed data for all tabs. ## ACTION INTENTS **save-questions**: Receives full questions JSON array. Delete all existing questions, re-create with all fields (title, type, description, required, position, settings, logic, imageUrl) and all answer fields (text, imageUrl, score, productTags, position, metadata). This is the "nuclear save" pattern — simple but effective. **save-design**: Receives title, description, styling JSON. Updates quiz. **save-settings**: Receives title, description, slug, type, settings JSON. Updates quiz. Must validate slug uniqueness (excluding current quiz). **save-logic**: Receives logic data as JSON. For each question, updates the logic field. **publish**: Set status to "active", publishedAt. **unpublish**: Set status to "draft". **delete**: Delete quiz, redirect to /app/quizzes. ## MAIN COMPONENT State: - `questions: Question[]` — local state, initialized from loader - `selectedQuestionIndex: number` - `design: DesignSettings` — local state for design tab - `settings: QuizSettings` — local state for settings tab - `selectedTab: number` — active tab index (0-4) - `deleteModalOpen: boolean` - `hasUnsavedChanges: boolean` — track if any local state differs from loader data Page header: - Title: quiz.title - Back action: navigate to /app/quizzes - Title metadata: Status badge (Live = success, Draft = attention) - Primary action: "Save" button (calls appropriate save handler based on active tab) - Secondary actions: Preview, Publish/Unpublish, Delete Tabs (Polaris `` component, fitted): 1. Questions 2. Product Mapping 3. Design 4. Settings 5. Logic Each tab renders its component inside a ``. ## QUESTION TYPES CONFIG (for the type picker and type-specific editor switching) ```typescript const QUESTION_TYPES = [ { label: "Single choice", value: "multiple-choice", icon: "📝", hasAnswers: true }, { label: "Image choice", value: "image-choice", icon: "🖼️", hasAnswers: true }, { label: "Dropdown", value: "dropdown", icon: "📋", hasAnswers: true }, { label: "Slider", value: "slider", icon: "🎚️", hasAnswers: false }, { label: "Text input", value: "text-input", icon: "✍️", hasAnswers: false }, { label: "Email capture", value: "email", icon: "📧", hasAnswers: false }, { label: "Rating", value: "rating", icon: "⭐", hasAnswers: false }, ] as const; ``` ## IMPORTANT NOTES - When changing question type: if switching from a type WITH answers to one WITHOUT, keep the answers in state (don't delete). If switching back, they reappear. Only the display changes. - Score field for each answer: use a small TextField with type="number" and width constraint - Product tags per answer: show as Polaris Tag components with remove, plus an "Add tag" input - The entire questions array is saved as one atomic operation (delete all, re-create) - All JSON fields must use parseSafe for reads and JSON.stringify for writes - Use `showToast` from `../utils/toast` for all feedback (not Polaris Toast component) - Use FormLayout for form fields grouping - Use Box with background tokens for visual hierarchy - Use Divider between sections - Empty states with EmptyState or Banner components - Delete confirmation via Modal ## FILE SIZE NOTE This file will be large (~1800-2200 lines). That's expected for a feature-rich quiz editor. Keep the code clean and well-organized with clear section comments. WRITE the complete rebuilt file at `/Users/yashbaldha/Desktop/Shopify App/QuizSnap/app/routes/app.quizzes.$id.tsx`.
